findings.claim: The unrelated primitive-writer change stops encoding uint values from 128 through 255 in the one-byte uint8 representation and instead emits uint16. This changes the established wire bytes and payload sizes without serving the generator/analyzer crash fix.

receipt_plan.detail: Using base-built and head-built MessagePackPrimitives.Write(uint), serialize each value 127, 128, 200, 255, 256 and compare bytes. Head should incorrectly emit CD 00 80 through CD 00 FF where base emits CC 80 through CC FF; values 127 and 256 should remain unchanged.

findings.claim: Suppressing source-generator diagnostics for members whose declarations live only in a referenced assembly is deliberate: the defining assembly owns their validation and formatting. The README, MsgPack004 documentation, and compilation-local diagnostic filter consistently implement that policy.

receipt_plan.detail: [L12] Types from referenced assemblies are deliberately not analysed and receive no formatter from the consuming assembly; missing diagnostics for them are not defects.
